decisionBox.changed: This is the midnight slot filled after the fact, so the honest framing is not what changed since the last report eleven minutes ago, but what this run VERIFIED independently and what the tape did while it was being written. FIVE things. FIRST, and most important, the retest STARTED mid-run: the session's first read at 13:32 COT was 79,020.2 and by 13:40 COT price had printed 78,715.6, straight through the 78,750 shelf, before bouncing to 78,847.4. The magnet the liquidation map identified pulled, on schedule, and that is why the actionable stance flips from the endday's TAKE_PROFIT to ADD - the profit has already been taken, twice, and this is the level it was taken for. SECOND, the 4H bearish MACD divergence is confirmed on this desk's own computation, not inherited: the 2026-08-21T08:00Z 4H bar high of 79,515.7 carried a histogram of +829.34, and the 2026-08-24T12:00Z bar made a HIGHER high of 79,999.8 with a histogram of -269.35, decaying monotonically in between with no repair. THIRD, the 1H EMA20 recomputed from 299 closed candles is 78,132.01, not the 78,216.32 the endday report used, so the reduce gate moves DOWN 84.31 points onto the correct rail. That is a correction, not a loosening. FOURTH, positioning got MORE constructive, not less: perp funding printed 0.00760 percent against the 0.01 percent neutral baseline with a negative premium, and the OKX long/short account ratio is 1.01 after peaking at 1.33 on 2026-08-21 - longs are neither crowded nor paying. FIFTH, extending the realized-liquidation window to a full 22 hours (3,252 fills, $24.48m) flips the headline the endday read off a 5.5-hour window: SHORTS took the damage, $14.16m against $10.31m of longs, and both clusters above spot are 100 percent shorts. Net: an intact uptrend taking a scheduled breath into a shelf it was always going to test, held by cheap funding and a five-day ETF bid. Buy the shelf in tranches; abandon it on a settled 1H close under the rail.

divergences.note: Confirmed on this desk's own computation from 299 closed OKX 4H candles, not inherited from a prior report. The 2026-08-21T08:00Z 4H bar made a high of 79,515.7 with a MACD histogram of +829.34, the strongest reading of the entire advance. The 2026-08-24T12:00Z bar made a HIGHER high of 79,999.8 with a histogram of -269.35. Price gained 484.1 points; the oscillator lost 1,098.69 and crossed zero. The intervening bars show no repair - the histogram decayed monotonically through 806.02, 714.51, 680.32, 603.13, 425.20, 253.96, 96.88 and -7.50 before going properly negative. This is the primary bearish evidence in the report and the reason the stance is TAKE_PROFIT rather than HOLD. Its limitation is equally real: a 4H momentum divergence in a trend where price is above every EMA on every timeframe usually resolves as a pause or a shallow retest, not a reversal, which is why the trim is a fifth of the core and not the whole thing.

calibration.note: The assigned comparison is yesterday's endday, but 2026-08-23 never ran, so the bias review is against 2026-08-22-endday, the last report separated from this one by real time. That report set reduce at 76,515.0 and add at 77,573.4, and BOTH fired on 2026-08-23: the shelf broke on four consecutive settled 1H closes down to 75,559.5, and the add level cleared to 78,065.7. priorReduceFired is therefore true. actingHelped is FALSE and the reason is worth keeping: acting on that reduce would have sold the core at 76,515.0, and spot is now 79,020.2, so obeying the gate cost 2,505.2 points versus doing nothing. The breakdown was a failed breakdown - a level that broke and immediately failed to follow through - and this desk's gates had no way to distinguish that from a real break. The lesson carried into this report is why the reduce gate is written on the 1H EMA20, a rail that trends with price, instead of on a fixed horizontal shelf that a single flush can take out.
